narr: A thunderstorm anchored and redeveloping over higher terrain near Marble NC produced up to 8 inches of rain.
ev: Multiple residences being evacuated due to rising flood waters in Marble NC.
Flooded stream approaching the base of a house.

Multiple roads inundated. Multiple structures flooded. Some roadside washouts. For the Marble flash flood event, damages were estimated to be at least $1,000,000, with $750,000 of that going to road repair, and the remainder toward properties.
